issue.title: Remove the Sphinx 9 builtin cross-reference workaround once sphinx-doc/sphinx#14223 is fixed
issue.body:
related: #74168 

### Body
<!-- HUMAN SUMMARY -->
Check when https://github.com/sphinx-doc/sphinx/issues/14223 is resolved, then figure out whether the workaround implemented in #74168 can be removed.
<!-- END OF HUMAN SUMMARY -->

<details><summary>AI Summary</summary>

Sphinx 9 (used by the docs build on Python 3.11+) falls back from a `py:class` lookup to a fuzzy `py:data`/`py:attr` search when resolving annotation cross-references. A builtin such as `type` or `object` in an annotation then matches every documented attribute with that name, and the docs build fails with "more than one target found for cross-reference". This is the upstream regression sphinx-doc/sphinx#14223.

The docs build works around it with the `python_builtin_xrefs` extension in `devel-common/src/sphinx_exts/`, which skips that fallback for builtin names so they resolve to the Python documentation as in Sphinx 8.

**Follow-up:** once sphinx-doc/sphinx#14223 is fixed in every Sphinx version the docs build resolves (9.0.x is the last line for Python 3.11), remove `python_builtin_xrefs.py`, its entry in `BASIC_SPHINX_EXTENSIONS` and its test.

**Done when:** the docs build passes on all supported Python versions without the extension.

</details>
